PLAN:
- Stage 0 — Contracts & harness (no new agents):
  - Define `candidate_signal` schema (id, agent_origin, hypothesis, feature_spec, cell_scope, evidence_ref, maker_sig/checker_sig, regime_tags, status).
  - Write candidates to a new `candidates/` evidence directory; add flag `SWARM_ENABLED=false` default; orchestrator = single Python `swarm_runner.py` invoked by existing overnight loop (Claude Code or cron), not Slate.
- Stage 1 — Two agents, offline-only:
  - Idea Generator: nightly scan of weather/NWP papers + KalshiML bias diagnostics (cal_err heatmaps, drift demotions, worst cells) → emits candidate hypotheses into `candidates/` (status=PROPOSED).
  - Feature Engineer: consumes PROPOSED items, materializes feature columns behind `SWARM_FEATURES` flag, appends to feature registry; no training impact yet.
- Stage 2 — Backtester + Validator (maker-checker):
  - Backtester agent: runs candidate on settled OOS slices using existing backtest/evidence machinery; writes raw evidence rows.
  - Validator agent: independent recompute (different code path), enforces existing bars unchanged (cal_err, edge, n_eff/events/days, family borrow); only marks VALIDATED if existing gate passes as-is; maker ≠ checker keys/prompts.
- Stage 3 — Regime Auditor + Decomposer:
  - Regime Auditor: tags candidates/evidence with synoptic/seasonal regime labels; flags candidates whose edge concentrates in one regime; feeds adaptive_tree axes instead of new regime framework.
  - Factor/Residual Decomposer: decomposes candidate P&L vs existing signals (residual orthogonality check); rejects candidates with corr > threshold to armed cells (protects independence guard).
- Stage 4 — Integration:
  - VALIDATED candidates enter existing evidence → recompute → LEARNING→PROBATION→ARMED path as new cells; swarm never bypasses gates.
  - Add swarm provenance columns to cell_states; dashboard/metrics for candidate funnel counts.
- Stage 5 — Overnight continuous runs:
  - Schedule full swarm loop nightly; weekly human review of funnel; promote `SWARM_ENABLED=true` for staging only after N weeks of clean runs; execution paths untouched throughout (DRY_RUN unchanged).

RISKS:
- Agent-generated features leak future info (NWP issue times) — mitigated by Validator recompute + stamping checks.
- Feature-snoop inflation: many candidates → false discoveries — mitigated by unchanged OOS bars + multiplicity note in Validator (BH-style screen before submission).
- Short weather history → regime overfit — mitigated by Regime Auditor requiring ≥2 seasons/regimes where data allows, else status capped at PROBATION-input only.
- Compute/runtime creep from nightly swarm — mitigated by budget caps per agent, dedup cache.
- Correlated candidates inflate n_eff — mitigated by Decomposer orthogonality gate before evidence ingestion.
- Prompt/LLM nondeterminism — mitigated by persisted agent I/O logs, seed pinning where possible.

CHECKPOINTS:
- C1: candidate schema + flags merged; zero behavior change with flags off (diff test on backtests).
- C2: Stage 1 produces ≥5 well-formed candidates; 100% parse against schema.
- C3: Validator reproduces Backtester metrics within tolerance on 100% of candidates; ≥1 known-good and ≥1 known-bad control candidate classified correctly.
- C4: Decomposer rejects a deliberately correlated control candidate.
- C5: A VALIDATED candidate flows through existing promotion path with identical gate outcomes as manual submission.
- C6: 4+ weeks nightly runs, no unflagged state mutation, funnel metrics reviewed.

IF_FAIL:
- C2 fail → fix schema/prompts; do not proceed to Backtester.
- C3 fail → halt swarm; audit for leakage/stamping bugs; swarm stays read-only until fixed.
- C5 fail → integration bug; revert integration commit, keep Stages 1–3 offline.
- Any live-path anomaly → `SWARM_ENABLED=false`; existing system runs unchanged by construction.
- Sustained 0 validated candidates after 8 weeks → reduce scope to Idea Generator + Decomposer as advisory-only tools.

DECISION_RULES:
- Never relax existing promotion bars or independence guards; swarm output only enters via standard evidence path.
- Reuse adaptive_tree/model_skill/evidence machinery; introduce new framework only if a concrete reuse attempt fails twice.
- Stay on Python orchestrator/Claude Code; adopt Slate only if agent count or state complexity demonstrably exceeds orchestrator capacity (measured, not assumed).
- Additive + flag-gated only; any change requiring modification of gate logic is rejected at design review.
- Treat execution paths as out of scope until ≥1 swarm-originated cell reaches ARMED through the unmodified path.
